items.reviewer_comment: Manuscript relies on too much supplementary material and tries to present too much information.
items.implementation_action: Run concept budget and manuscript reconciliation gates; keep broad case suite as repo/tutorial material rather than main narrative.
items.manuscript_action: Limit headline concepts to directional EVoP, Perspective Acceptability Frontier, and perspective regime discovery.

items.reviewer_comment: Discuss risks of asymmetric societal-perspective adoption across public sectors without scope creep.
items.implementation_action: Keep Value of Harmonisation as a scoped extension and prevent it becoming a fourth headline concept.
items.manuscript_action: Add one bounded paragraph in discussion and optional supplement note.

items.reviewer_comment: Explain human-capital and friction-cost methods in the New Zealand context.
items.implementation_action: Add societal-cost taxonomy and parameter provenance fields for productivity method/source.
items.manuscript_action: Replace generic HC/FC restatement with NZ-specific assumption table and scenario language.

items.reviewer_comment: Stakeholder preferences appear without methodological explanation.
items.implementation_action: Require stakeholder weights to be represented as scenario weights unless elicited data are available.
items.manuscript_action: Clarify that stakeholder mixtures are illustrative/scenario-based unless separately elicited.

items.reviewer_comment: Discussion could benefit from considering VOI results.
items.implementation_action: Add no-orphan result manifests linking VOI/VoP outputs to figures and tables.
items.manuscript_action: Add concise VOI interpretation only where it supports the perspective-regret narrative.

items.reviewer_comment: Multiple interventions reduce analytical depth and methodological credibility.
items.implementation_action: Grade each case contract as policy-grade, empirical tutorial, or fixture; promote one deep housing-insulation exemplar.
items.manuscript_action: Separate deep case from comparative landscape/tutorial suite.

items.reviewer_comment: Limited structured comparison with existing economic evaluations and societal-perspective literature.
items.implementation_action: Add source ledgers and software/literature comparison ledger; require citation/source fields for every parameter.
items.manuscript_action: Add concise structured comparison section and cite parameter sources in main text tables.

items.reviewer_comment: Parameter choices, WTP threshold, and discount rates are insufficiently documented.
items.implementation_action: Run evidence_audit.py and require evidence ledgers/model cards before empirical claims.
items.manuscript_action: Add assumption ledger table to main manuscript and threshold/discount scenario language.

items.reviewer_comment: Three-state Markov models lack clinical/epidemiological justification.
items.implementation_action: Require a model card for every case with model family, justification, omissions, and validation status.
items.manuscript_action: Avoid presenting all cases as policy-grade; provide model structure rationale for the deep exemplar.

items.reviewer_comment: Societal perspective is largely productivity and insufficiently grounded in included/excluded effects.
items.implementation_action: Add structured societal-cost taxonomy and evidence-ledger fields by cost component.
items.manuscript_action: State included and excluded societal components per case; do not call partial components complete societal perspective.

items.reviewer_comment: Sensitivity analysis does not clarify whether parameter correlations were considered.
items.implementation_action: Add factorial/GSA/regime discovery manifest with correlation/scenario metadata.
items.manuscript_action: Report correlation assumptions and classify GSA/clustering as perspective regime discovery.

items.reviewer_comment: Including productivity as a cost-reducing impact improving ICERs is expected rather than analytically novel.
items.implementation_action: Correct EVoP semantics and produce Perspective Acceptability Frontier outputs via voiage.
items.manuscript_action: Frame novelty as quantifiable perspective-regret and decision frontier, not as societal bonus.
